quote: Theorem 1. If a j (t) is a solution to system (19) with a j (0) ≥ 0, ∀j and (32) E B(J) (0) ≥ q J for some sufficiently large integer J ≥ j 0 and λ −2 < q < 1, then the H α norm of the solution becomes unbounded in finite-time, for any α > 0.
hypotheses: a_j(t) solves the infinite chain (19) with lambda > 1, real a_j
non-negative data a_j(0) >= 0 for all j
E_B(J)(0) >= q^J for some sufficiently large J >= j_0, with lambda^-2 < q < 1
source_id: arXiv:math/0410380v2 (F. Waleffe, On some dyadic models of the Euler equations), Theorem 1
